prose.philosophical_reflection: Two passions are lodged at the praxis (action) stage: agonia (anguished anxiety) — the sense that an imminent evil is overtaking you and cannot be averted — and oknos (sluggishness / reluctance to act) — the pull toward inaction as the safer path. This is a single snapshot; no trajectory data is available to assess your direction of travel. The EUPATHEIA_BOUNDARY deferral also applies: whether the care you are bringing to the founder's situation reflects boulesis (rational wishing) — wanting what virtue would have you want — or a subtler epithumia (irrational desire) craving a good outcome as though it were genuinely yours to secure cannot be confirmed from this instance alone. What the assessment does confirm is that phronesis (practical wisdom), dikaiosyne (justice), and andreia (courage) are all engaged, and the correct judgement is already in your possession: the founder's reception of your recommendation is a preferred indifferent, and your agitation is the false judgement that virtue depends on its outcome — carry that forward as the ground you stand on when you write.
prose.improvement_guidance: The false judgement to correct is the assumption that an imminent evil is overtaking you and cannot be averted; replace it with the assessment that the founder's reception of your recommendation is a preferred indifferent, ranked by axia (worth/value) well below the quality of the judgement you bring to writing it. This is a praxis-stage correction — the passions have already moved into action, so the work is to interrupt the impulse before it shapes what you write or whether you write it at all. Notice the moment you feel the pull to soften the evidence-gated framing or to hedge the recommendation in order to manage how it lands: that is oknos and agonia running, not your ruling faculty. The items within your prohairesis (moral choice / ruling faculty) are clear — the reframe to evidence gates, the statement of observed unit economics as fact, the cost base as fact, the removal of month-twelve revenue claims — and none of them depend on how the founder weighs his personal runway or the lawyer cost already committed, which are outside it. Practise this concretely: before you write the first sentence of the recommendation, name the two passions aloud or on paper, set them aside as the false judgements they are, and then write from the corrected judgement — that the honest, evidence-grounded case is the only thing within your prohairesis, and it is enough.
prose.summary: Your reasoning is reflexive but agitated, with agonia and oknos lodged at the action stage, where the false judgement that the founder's reception determines your standing requires correction before you write.
prose.open_deferrals_prose: Across recent days, when the founder arose in this domain — was your inner state actually boulesis, wanting what virtue would have you want without grasping, or was it more like epithumia, craving a good outcome for him (or for yourself through him) as though it were a genuine good you could secure?
